column3: A member of the public sends a real FOI request
It lands in the council's shared FOI mailbox in Outlook
FOI Sentinel pulls it from Outlook through Microsoft Graph
Straight into Snowflake, with no middleware
Run the pipeline and follow every step
Classified, then triaged: category, priority, complexity, effort
It also checks section 14 vexatious and section 21 duplicate
It matches the council's own records and peer precedent
Then drafts a grounded, cited answer
And self-checks for groundedness and coverage first
A ready-to-send letter, every figure traceable to source
The officer reviews and sends. Nothing leaves without sign-off
